decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 12/2/08, the erection of a hip to gable mansard roof extension measuring 3.9m depth by 2.9m high by 8m width and the rear dormer would measure 3.8m depth by 2.4m high by 5.7m wide and two front roof lights, and a single storey rear extension measuring 4.5m depth by 5.7m across the rear of the house by 3m high was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development does not fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes A and B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the total of the extensions is over 70m3.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a rear roof extension with hip to gable conversion, juliette balcony and front roof windows. Erection of single storey rear extension to the house.
